easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.
